title: Odd-power series sum transfer
statement: Let $z,a\in\mathbb{R}$. If the series with terms given by the arcsine series coefficient of index $j$ multiplied by $z^{2j+1}$ has sum $a$, then the series with terms given by the coefficient of exponent $k$ multiplied by $z^k$ also has sum $a$.
hypotheses_covered: The series with terms $c_j z^{2j+1}$ has sum $a$, where $c_j$ is the arcsine series coefficient
